notes.title: Dawnfolk, But Your Way – Modding Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I'm thrilled to finally release the Modding Update for Dawnfolk!

[previewyoutube=ablGMImjJgk;full][/previewyoutube]

🎉 [b]The big news? Modding is here![/b]
You can now create your own mods or download community-made ones to customize your experience and expand the game’s possibilities.

This update also includes:
[list]
[*]     Tons of bug fixes thanks to community reports
[*]     Major performance boosts (it could probably run on a toaster now!)
[/list]
[h1]🔧[b] Featured Mods[/b][/h1]

To kick things off, I’ve made two official mods:

    [b]The Light Spire[/b]: A powerful new science building for the Light Craters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43892694/31fb789f2a9370da2ab66ffca3af4e00a96e73ff.png[/img]

    [b]The Icylands[/b]: A snowy, challenging new level featuring the Iskaar, a new race that you can ally with and customize.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43892694/0d731c56fb54c07b652663ced38164698c3c04c5.png[/img]

There’s also a [b]cheat menu[/b] mod made by a community member, and more mods are already in the works!

I can’t wait to see what kind of creative ideas you all bring to life.

[h1]📥 [b]How to Install Mods[/b][/h1]

[olist]
[*]     Head to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2308630/workshop/]Steam Workshop[/url]
[*]     Subscribe to the mods you want
[*]     They’ll show up in-game automatically! You can enable or disable them via the Main Menu into Options and Mods.
[/olist]

[h1]✏️ [b]Want to Create Your Own Mod?[/b][/h1]

I’ve put together a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3459698054]detailed guide[/url] with examples to help you get started. Whether you’re tweaking balance, adding content, or making something totally wild, it’s all possible now.

Thanks again for playing and supporting the game.

Take care,
– Darenn

notes.title: New Playtest! (coming modding update)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
I'm running a new playtest for 1 week to test the new mods of Dawnfolk! 🎨 ⚙️ 
The goal is simple: [b]Install the mods and play the new level[/b] I made using modding tools for the game and let me know what you think and if you find issues or bugs.
[list]
[*] Light Spire adds a new science building for the light well with incredible powers!,
[*] Icylands adds a new levels including a snow biome and a new race: the Iskarr. You can specialize the Iskarr to get more resources.,
[/list]
I've worked hard on optimizing the game so it can run smoothly a on toaster, it's possible you'll find new bugs that were not there before. 😅 
[h1]HOW TO PLAY:[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Switch to the playtest branch of the game on Steam (properties->beta->playtest, see screenshots below).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43892694/050faba0a75f30f6b3883ed4c6d3c799f2b79053.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43892694/4cece4ee6ec8e302061c7434f65045c77e427d46.png[/img]
[*] Go to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=2308630&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems]workshop [/url]and subscribe to the mods.
[*] Run the game, and make sure the mods are enabled in the main menu in "options > mods",
[*] Press the play button, go at the top and play the "icyland" level.
[/olist]

Want to create your own mod? Follow the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3459698054]guide[/url].

Have fun!

- Darenn

notes.title: I improved Dawnfolk based on your feedback! (1.0.21 update)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Today I'd like to share with you the new improvements I added to Dawnfolk based on your feedback. Check out the video to see them all in action!

[previewyoutube=pMnc6GNBsuE;full][/previewyoutube]

Improvements:
[olist]
[*][b] Turn-based mode:[/b] You can force the game to always pause time by default, allowing you to play completely turn based without stopping the game animations. The option is in the accessibility menu.
[*] The game [b]auto saves[/b] every 10 days.
[*] Puzzles now show you which [b]rank[/b] you got directly in the menu (bronze star, silver star or gold star)
[*] You can force the game to [b]use the glyphs[/b] from Xbox, Playstation or Switch controllers.
[*] Added [b]warning message[/b] to warn player that cheats disable achievements and rewards.
[*] You can also destroy volcanoes with the research from the miner's guild.
[*] Orc camps are now cheaper to fight and more expansive to make peace with.
[*] Pray icon change
[*] Changed the descriptions of the Farm and Animals science buildings
[*] Mouse is forced in the middle of the screen when activating it to avoid loosing the main menu (you can press escape to come back to the center).
[*] Enter key on keyboard can be used instead of space
[*] Backspace key on keyboard can be used instead of escape to leave the action menu.
[*] Bigger pan with the mouse
[*] Video and Sound parameters are not synced on the steam cloud. This allows you to play on different computers with different settings.
[*] Volcanoes have better chance of erupting in puzzle maps.
[/olist]

Bug fixes:
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug that would make market/pray/dragon prices not increase in endless
[*] Fixed orcs moonwalking in fight mini-games
[*] Fixed price of arks
[*] A lot more smaller ones reported on discord
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Update 1.0.20
notes.notes:
I’ve fixed a lot of minor bugs reported by the community! While I didn’t track every single one, here’s an approximate list of what’s been addressed.

If you’re still experiencing [b]CRASHES[/b], please reach out to me at [b]darenn@dawnfolk.com[/b]. These are often tricky to fix because they can be specific to your system, and I may not be able to reproduce them on my end. Your reports really help, and I want everyone to have the best possible experience with the game.

Thanks for your support!

[h1]
Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]     Fixed achievement bug "green thumb".
[*]     Black monoliths no longer set population to 0 after completion.
[*]     Fixed issue where mouse control wouldn't work until restarting the game.
[*]     Enter key now works in the menu.
[*]     Fixed "Random Illuminate" not counting towards the achievement.
[*]     Fixed pause time in photo mode and events.
[*]     Fixed "Sick" status breaking when using the lighthouse upgrade.
[*]     Fixed mines next to forges losing their forge bonus when motivated.
[*]     Fixed an issue where the second monolith in Arks could arrive too soon.
[*]     "Bullied" effect now correctly triggers when elves destroy buildings.
[*]     Befriending orcs mini-games does correctly give a food bonus now.
[*]     Fixed game exiting the menu when deleting the last save in SAVE MODE.
[*]     Fixed adjacency bonus calculation issues.
[*]     Save sync issues fixed.
[*]     Fixed bug preventing descriptions from refreshing after dialogs and actions.
[*]     Fixed missing dialog issue in French.
[*]     Disabled mouse button functionality on Steam Deck.
[*]     Pause menu now opens correctly on external controllers.
[*]     No action possible in photo mode.
[*]     Photo mode is pause.
[*]     Fixed berry game not improving properly.
[*]     Achievements in "Badlands" now correctly unlock after killing all required enemies.
[*]     Fixed dialogue display bug in the Treasure Hunter quest.
[*]     Fixed an issue where dragons could spawn on the Tower of Light.
[*]     Fixed dwarf achievement not unlocking on hard difficulty.
[*]     Fixed enchanted forest elf flag issue when winning properly.
[*]     Fixed save sync issues between Steam Deck and PC.
[*]     Fixed story mode Tower of Light not opening from the main menu.
[*]     Mini-games now correctly subtract numbers upon perfect score.
[*]     Corrected French translation for sheep breeding.
[/list]

notes.title: Play Dawnfolk with your Mouse! (update 1.0.16)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Right after release, I received a lot of requests from the community to add mouse controls to the game.

So I did!

You can enable it in Options > Controls > Enable Mouse. If you refunded the game, you can still try it in the demo. I crunched hard to implement this as quickly as possible, so I didn’t have much time for thorough testing. Please let me know if you run into any weird issues!

Check out the video below to see everything you can do with the mouse and why it wasn’t included before release.

[previewyoutube=F7UPeAkhwTA;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks again for all the feedback: this game keeps getting better thanks of you! I also want to heartily thank everyone leaving reviews. It’s such a delight to read them, and they give me the energy I need to keep working hard and making you happy.

Take care!

- Darenn

notes.title: Dawnfolk is Out! Rewatch the live release and check out some fun facts
notes.notes:
My game Dawnfolk is finally out! Thank you so much for sticking with me until the end. ❤️

Are you ready to rebuild your realm and bring light back to the world? 🔥  

I released the game during a live stream, answering tons of questions about the game, about me and the future. You can watch this [url=https://youtube.com/live/3tYlXbZi__4]here[/url].

Ready for some fun facts about the development of the game? Read more below!




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43892694/86c3902e2f5cbb157a30232c1804e82974d746b2.png[/img]

I made the whole game on my own at this desk for the past two years. I don’t even want to imagine the total hours I’ve spent here. And YES, I’m using only one screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43892694/1133360690a3ee9f1dede29722655b40d9f76928.png[/img]

I completed 1,678 different tasks while making this game. But don’t take that number too seriously; One of those tasks was literally “Add 99 achievements.” Quite the task.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43892694/6eae9c4a57908f4e592f36617a36ffdfa2720899.png[/img]

This is the LAST thing I added to the game, five hours before release: the control scheme in the options. This task had been sitting there for about a year, but I just kept pushing it back. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43892694/dc3a285a1a737616bf5798d55450c7c11b6011ee.png[/img]

Here’s the most up-to-date wishlist graph before release. More than 35k wishlists! I'm so grateful to all those player believing in my game and waiting to get their hands on it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43892694/0e0394ce1df52fdd3c12c9166c8a0a45fa6742b0.png[/img]

The first version of the game was made during LowRez Jam, where my goal was to make a minimalist city builder that fit within 64x64 resolution. Kind of crazy to look back on that after two years.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43892694/0f476704bb4fc384f7d1551ddcf55814a45e7e42.png[/img]

The original name of the game was “Lueur”, which means “glimmer” or “low light” in French. But I had to change it. Why? If you don't speak french, go do something else for 5 minutes, then try to write the name back in the replies of this post. You'll understand!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43892694/dc9911e67722b9e530bec3fdc961911cb9817d6f.png[/img]

Meet my project manager, Oréo (or "Loulou" for family and friends)! His main job? Forcing me to take breaks by sitting on my keyboard and demanding hugs.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43892694/ea48d054513e3c64d2d83aff7abfc6f3fe1dca52.jpg[/img]

One of the beta testers actually beat the game before release: all 99 achievements completed in 40 hours (and he rushed!). That’s crazy.

[previewyoutube=i4nD8r3jVI8;full][/previewyoutube]

For two years, this was the only music in the game. I have no idea how testers put up with it all this time, because I know I couldn’t. Two weeks before launch, I finally added seven more tracks.

Thanks for reading the thread, I hope you had fun!

Please share the game with your friends, and take care.

- Darenn

notes.title: Dawnfolk has a release date - and a new demo!
notes.notes:
Big news: Dawnfolk finally has a release date! 🥹 It feels surreal to see the light at the end of the tunnel after 2 years of creating this game all alone in my bedroom. Time to buckle down and bring it across the finish line.

[previewyoutube=a6W0z3lX5go;full][/previewyoutube]

To celebrate, I added even more content to the demo. You'll have access to:
[list]
[*] The 2 first story levels
[*] The 2 first puzzles
[*] The first expedition (challenge)
[*] The new biomes of the endless mode
[*] The new sandbox mode to create your dream city!
[/list]

I'm still working hard to improve the game, so I’d love to hear your thoughts.

Take care!
